findings.summary: The header-injection check (assertValidHeaderValue) was removed and normalizeValue now silently strips CR/LF/control characters instead of rejecting them, so injection attempts go unnoticed and merged values can change meaning (e.g. pass allowlist checks).

judge.reason: Describes the known problem that values are silently rewritten instead of rejected, not the Unicode-stripping bug.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Describes the known problem that values are silently rewritten instead of rejected, not the Unicode-stripping bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: The regex [^\x09\x20-\x7E\x80-\xFF] silently drops \x7F and all code points above 0xFF (e.g. € or CJK), corrupting header values without error, and tests don't cover it.

judge.reason: Identifies the regex dropping all code points above 0xFF, which is the b1 defect.

votes.label: hit
votes.reason: Identifies the regex dropping all code points above 0xFF, which is the b1 defect.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: trimSPorHTAB now trims leading and trailing whitespace on every header value, a behavior change for all callers beyond the injection case.

judge.reason: Trimming whitespace is not the Unicode stripping defect, and it is unlikely to be a real regression.

votes.label: false_alarm
votes.reason: Trimming whitespace is not the Unicode stripping defect, and it is unlikely to be a real regression.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: Loopback aliasing means no_proxy=localhost now also bypasses the proxy for 127.0.0.1 and [::1] and vice versa, which is wider than what the user typed (deliberate but worth noting).

judge.reason: Matches the known loopback aliasing problem in the proxy change.

votes.label: valid_other
votes.reason: Matches the known loopback aliasing problem in the proxy change.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Updated tests only assert the new sanitizing behavior and do not check that header injection is detected or rejected.

judge.reason: Test coverage gap for injection rejection is not tied to the answer-key bug, and rejection is no longer the intended behavior.
